answer: Agents lock bonded stake and commit to an epoch polynomial whose coefficients bind their Semaphore identity; RLN proofs authorize rate-limited messages without exposing the secret. If falcon and zephyr reuse a nullifier in one epoch, their distinct proofs expose Shamir shares that interpolate the private key, allowing the contract to slash collateral immediately. This deterrent holds even at the ledge of anonymity: duplicate messages are linkable, while valid unique messages remain private.
